card_order_next_and_role_contracts.scope: Explicit contract markers and canonical order block; not an LLM semantic review.

rag_lock_manifest_and_slices.scope: Pinned blob metadata equality and local excerpt bytes; original whole blobs are not excerpt files.

reference_structure.exclusion_basis: split=reference is the required exclusion; training_allowed is optional metadata.

limits: No semantic acceptance, generator output or learning measurement is asserted.
External URLs not present in the pinned catalog are syntax-checked, not fetched.
RAG excerpt links may be historical and are outside link checking.
Original full source blob bytes are not reconstructed from reviewed excerpts.

verification_corrections.scope: Removed a checker-only requirement absent from the data contract. Reference exclusion uses mandatory split=reference; optional training_allowed is reported without requiring its presence.
verification_corrections.prepare_evidence: Retained unchanged from the one bounded 128-stream prepare run in this report.
